status: declared before candidate normalized values are calculated
scope: Conditional normalization check only; not reproduction of QC inclusion decisions or unchanged end-to-end application validation
input: Public DCC files and PKC, with the exact sample and target sets supplied in the published normalized matrix
method: retain published target identifiers including the negative-control target
basis: The paper-linked repository explicitly applies count shifting, GeomxTools Q3 normalization, and plain log2. Its cohort and QC settings are not confirmed to generate this GEO matrix.
restrictions: Do not adjust transformations or thresholds after seeing errors to force agreement
Use published inclusion sets only as a conditioning assumption, not as independent validation of filtering
Separate negative-control results from endogenous gene results
Do not infer biological or clinical validity
